title: Obesity treatment with a doctor
what: The doctor helps you lose weight safely and for the long term. They look for causes, make a plan and follow your progress.
why: For excess weight, especially with high blood pressure, diabetes, joint pain or snoring; when you cannot lose weight on your own.
duration: the first visit usually takes 30 to 60 minutes, treatment takes months
tell_doctor: How your weight has changed and what you have already tried
Which medicines you take - some affect weight
If you have diabetes, high blood pressure or thyroid disease
How you sleep and whether you snore

prepare.title: Food diary
prepare.text: For 3 to 7 days write down everything you eat and drink. This helps the most.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: The doctor may order tests for sugar, cholesterol and hormones. Usually on an empty stomach.

prepare.title: Goal
prepare.text: Think about what you want to achieve and what gets in the way.

steps: The doctor asks about eating, activity, sleep and illnesses
Measures your weight, height, waist and blood pressure
Sometimes checks body composition on special scales
feel: Talking about weight can feel awkward - the doctor is there to help, not to judge
after: The usual goal is to lose 5 to 10% of your weight over a few months
Only a doctor prescribes weight-loss medicines
Regular visits help you keep the result

faq.a: Fast weight loss most often comes back. The doctor will choose a safe pace for you.

faq.q: Are there pills for excess weight?
faq.a: There are medicines, but only a doctor prescribes them and not for everyone.

reminders.text: Weight visit tomorrow. Take your food diary and recent test results.
